name_zh: 莫拉莱斯/玻利维亚/可可/原住民/总统/气候/海洋/埃沃/多民族
description_zh: 埃沃·莫拉莱斯 (1967-) 玻利维亚总统 (2006-2019) 平民总统，领导可可产业改革、原住民权利保护、气候正义运动、海洋出路战略，建立多民族国家，推动玻利维亚现代化，被誉为'可可总统'，推动玻利维亚民族觉醒和气候正义。
description_en: Evo Morales (1967-) Bolivian President (2006-2019) civilian president, led cocoa industry reform, indigenous rights protection, climate justice movement, ocean outlet strategy, established multi-national state, promoted Bolivian modernization, known as 'Cocoa President', promoted Bolivian national awakening and climate justice.
reason_zh: 莫拉莱斯代表拉丁美洲如何通过可可产业改革实现民族经济独立，如何保护原住民权利，如何推动气候正义和海洋出路战略，以及建立多民族国家如何推动国家现代化，体现了21世纪拉美的进步。
reason_en: Morales represents how Latin America achieves national economic independence through cocoa industry reform, protects indigenous rights, promotes climate justice and ocean outlet strategy, and establishes multi-national state to promote modernization, embodies 21st century Latin American progress.
